priorities.name: Top priority workstream
priorities.detail: What you lead and the objective it serves.

value_levers: How you earn beyond retainer (performance comp, commission, bonus)

notetaker._comment: Which AI meeting notetaker to read from. One at a time. Registered providers: granola, grain. Empty = infer from whichever API key is set in ~/.config/van-gogh/.env (GRANOLA_API_KEY / GRAIN_API_KEY).

channels._comment: How briefings are delivered. Email is the only channel implemented; Slack and WhatsApp are not in this release.

meeting_prep._comment: Prep emails before a call. Off until you ask for them. Mode 'each' mails one prep per meeting, lead_minutes ahead; mode 'daily' mails one email covering the whole day at daily_time. Sender and recipient come from the digest block.

notes._comment: The watcher between briefings. Every fifteen minutes it checks whether a counterparty replied on a front-page item, said a deal is off, or moved today's meeting, and mails you a Note with the reply already drafted. Off until you ask. At most daily_cap a day (the rest fold into Afternoon Tea), only between from and until, local time, never during a meeting. Sender and recipient come from the digest block.

cadence._comment: Capabilities that otherwise run only when you ask, each on its own schedule. All off until you turn one on. days are lowercase weekday names, time is 24h and computer-local. calendar-stub-check stubs yesterday's unrecorded meetings into the vault. relationship-radar flags contacts going cold. five-fifteen drafts the weekly client reports and leaves each as a draft, never sent. voice-calibration learns from the week's sent mail. voice-generator refreshes the tone profile and keeps the previous one beside it.

connectors_comment: Other systems Van Gogh may ask about a person before a call: a CRM, a help desk, anything connected on claude.ai. One entry per system: name (a short word you choose), server (as the connector is named in Claude), tools (only tools that read), about (one line on what it holds), use_for (leave as people). Add one with /van-gogh:add-connector rather than by hand, because it checks every tool against the connector first. What a connector returns is shown in a prep as a quotation from that system and is never used to change anything.

advisor._comment: The advisor reads your vault once a day after `time`, picks at most daily_cap things it could do for you, and asks. The list arrives by email and inside Morning Coffee and Afternoon Tea. You answer Y or N by replying to either, or in the Workbench. A yes leaves a draft, a file or a vault edit for you to check; nothing is sent to anyone. allow_send lets a reply of SEND plus the number send a draft it wrote, and stays off until you turn it on. Off until you ask. Sender and recipient come from the digest block.

scheduler._comment: Which version's scheduling questions have been answered, and what was declined. /van-gogh:check-updates asks once after an update about anything never offered, and stamps the version here so it does not ask twice.

travel._comment: Flight notices in the morning briefing. Trips are read from calendar events whose location names an airport code. Your home address is NOT set here: it goes in the private ~/.config/van-gogh/.env as VAN_GOGH_HOME_ADDRESS, because this file is synced into your vault and published.
